title: gastrolychnis ostenfeldii
intro: Gastrolychnis ostenfeldii, commonly known as Chinese gentian, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is believed to have health benefits such as improving digestion and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Gastrolychnis ostenfeldii include its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and dyspepsia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, loganic acid, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
